niche: a third-party logistics operator's peak stock-record gate for a grocery client: which of the eight distribution centres it runs for the client carry pick-face stock records accurate enough, at the moment counting stands down for the peak freeze, for the client's automated replenishment to order off them unattended, judged from a perpetual count programme whose cycle and exception counts each correct the record they read
answer: Let Thornacre's replenishment run unattended through the freeze at Hinckley, Daventry, Bellshill, Warrington, Magor and Avonmouth, and keep Thurrock and Doncaster on supervised replenishment (planned; the builder confirms it from the cut pack).
answer_source: design note, planned set (prototype proto2/tune3.py); replaced by the golden at ship
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the count history and reads Thornacre's standard and Corderoy's count programme correctly sets the exception counts aside as symptom-led, weights each centre's routine counts to its in-scope A, B and C mix and takes that rate as the share of correct records at the stand-down; it passes Magor and Hinckley only and holds back Daventry, Bellshill, Warrington and Avonmouth, which qualify, because every routine count read its record at the end of a cycle and then set it right, so the weighted rate is the accuracy of records as they fall due, not of the records each centre carries into the freeze.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the share of stock records that are right at one moment, which no count observes, and the inventory field's own count-programme logic decides it: a cycle or exception count both measures a record and sets it right, and a record goes wrong again only through the handling it takes before its next count, so the share at the stand-down is built face by face from each face's handling or time since its last count of any kind, with the accrual read off the routine counts alone; the generalist's correction (weight the counts to the population's class and flag cells) never reaches it, and with survey or clinic nouns in place nothing resets what it measures, so the task no longer reads the same.

spine.entity: one count task on one pick face (a cycle count or an exception count), with the system quantity, the first count, the supervisor recount where one was taken, the quantity posted, the result and the task's reason code

world.geography: United Kingdom, England, Scotland and Wales
world.org_type: third-party logistics operator running ambient, chilled and frozen distribution centres for a grocery retail client

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of units in a correct state at one moment, seen only through checks that record a unit's state just before setting it right; scheduled checks see each unit at the end of its interval and symptom-led checks see units because they were wrong, so the checked-unit rate, however reweighted to the population's cells, measures states that have since been reset, and the share at the moment is built unit by unit from what each has accrued since its own last check of any kind, with the accrual read from the scheduled checks alone.
driver_concrete: Corderoy's cycle and exception counts each record a pick face's system quantity against the physical count and then post the confirmed count as the record, so every count leaves the record right; the routine counts on the A, B and C cycles of four, eight and thirteen weeks see each record at the end of its cycle and the exception counts see records because a short pick or a negative balance showed them wrong, while at the stand-down each face is only part way through its cycle since its last count of any kind; so a centre's count accuracy, even with the exception counts set aside and the routine counts weighted to its A, B and C mix, understates the records it carries into the freeze, most where fast faces run long cycles, and Thornacre's 97.0 per cent gate passes six centres where the weighted count rate passes two.
stump: A competent solver takes each centre's share of correct records from its count history as the share of count tasks that matched the record and finds that no centre qualifies, all eight held on supervised replenishment, and its textbook correction (exception counts set aside as symptom-led, the routine counts weighted to the in-scope A, B and C mix) still passes only Magor and Hinckley; the step that lands it there is reading a count's result as the record's standing state, when every count also posts the confirmed quantity as the record, so routine counts see each record at the end of its cycle and exception counts see records because they were wrong, while at 06:00 on 7 December each face is only part way through its cycle since its last count of any kind, and built face by face from the accrual since that count, read off the routine counts alone, Hinckley, Daventry, Bellshill, Warrington, Magor and Avonmouth clear 97.0 per cent.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-11: shipped, then failed the portal's determinism QC with both reviewers (the standard error's construction was not forced: the old 7 and 4.3 read literally as sample SD over root n); the in-house Gate H pass called its first domain (energy-systems-utilities) a backdrop (H1); the estimand-route rework under general-statistics-data-science was cracked on the leak reader's first pass (the filed estimand named co-moving losses and the field reference named the node)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the standard error of a mean over entities that fail together through a shared parent node, so it has to be built over the nodes; an error that takes each entity as an independent unit understates it severalfold for a group concentrated behind few nodes, and the alert fires on what is node noise.
